primary_use_cases: Lower bounds and upper bounds for memory benchmarks: chunk+RAG vs stuffing entire history
deployment_options: Any vector DB + chunker; or extended context models
pricing_summary: Full-context = highest token cost; RAG = infra + embedding cost
integration_model: Application-managed: retrieve chunks at query time or pass full history to model
storage_backends: Vector indexes for RAG; none for full-context beyond chat logs
memory_tiers: Single retrieval index or raw transcript — no structured memory ops
graph_model: GraphRAG variants exist but not default baseline
extraction_approach: Chunking + embed at ingest; no structured fact extraction
update_operations: Re-embed chunks on new data; no DELETE/UPDATE semantics for facts
consolidation_strategy: Periodic reindex or summary of chunks
temporal_model: Weak — embeddings conflate outdated and current facts (temporal blindness)
agent_fact_handling: All turns embedded equally in chunks
retrieval_signals: Semantic chunk retrieval; BM25 in hybrid RAG
latency_profile: Full-context: high p95 at long histories (Mem0 cites ~9.87s median, 17s p95); RAG faster but recall-limited
token_efficiency: Full-context worst (~25k+ tokens/query in Mem0 comparisons); RAG moderate
locomo_scores: Full-context strong on some categories but fails cost/latency; RAG mid-tier on LoCoMo per Mem0 paper
beam_scores: Full-context fails at 1M–10M scale; purpose of BEAM benchmark
benchmark_methodology: Mem0 paper compares varying chunk sizes and k; full-context as upper bound reference
stated_unsolved_problems: Temporal blindness; missing relationships; context collapse at scale
known_limitations: Cannot selectively update facts; expensive; poor multi-hop without graph
memorable_has: Selective retrieval closer to Mem0 than raw RAG; still lacks fact-level updates
memorable_lacks: Published comparison runs vs these baselines on same harness
memorable_should_port: Benchmark suite must include RAG(k) and full-context arms per Mem0 paper methodology (C0)
memorable_should_skip: Positioning as RAG replacement — Memorable is structured memory layer
